description: Pump-out barge booking time; the first message never says which berth or how much water is in it. DISTILL-CANARY-5a9c07d4

turns.prompt: The harbourmaster at Ashmoor Marina wants the pump-out barge reserved and the booking sheet closes at noon. How many minutes should we book the barge for?

It is the visitors' pontoon, holding 8,500 litres, and the barge moves 340 litres per minute. Give the number alone, as digits, with no label. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
